columns.name: eligible_2027
columns.description: 1 if Treasury lists the tract as an eligible low-income community for the 2027 designations.

columns.name: rural_2027
columns.description: 1 if Treasury classifies the tract as comprised entirely of a rural area.

columns.name: poverty_rate
columns.description: Poverty rate, 2020-2024 ACS, as Treasury used it.

columns.name: median_family_income
columns.description: Median family income, 2020-2024 ACS (Treasury's input).

columns.name: area_median_family_income
columns.description: The comparison MFI Treasury applied: the CBSA's if in one, else the state's.

columns.name: mfi_ratio
columns.description: Tract MFI divided by the applicable area MFI.

columns.name: oz2018_population_share
columns.description: Share of the tract's 2020 population living in a 2018 Opportunity Zone (2010 tract), via the block crosswalk.

columns.name: rural_by_blocks
columns.description: 1 if the block-based reproduction finds the tract rural, 0 if not; null where not computed.

columns.name: rural_reason
columns.description: Why not rural, by blocks: 1 city over 50,000, 2 urban area touching one; null if rural or not computed.

columns.name: rural_city
columns.description: Index into lookups.ruralNames of the excluding city.

columns.name: rural_urban_area
columns.description: Index into lookups.ruralNames of the excluding urban area.

columns.name: rural_explanation
columns.description: 0 verified (block test agrees with Treasury), 1 unverified (they differ), 2 not computed.

columns.name: qct_2026
columns.description: 1 if a 2026 HUD Qualified Census Tract.

columns.name: dda_2026
columns.description: Difficult Development Area 2026: 0 none, 1 part of the tract, 2 all of it.

columns.name: dda_zcta_land_share
columns.description: Share of the tract's land in small-area (ZIP-based) DDAs.

columns.name: nmtc_lic
columns.description: 1 if an NMTC low-income community (2016-2020 ACS); null in island areas (not covered).

columns.name: nmtc_high_migration
columns.description: 1 if NMTC-eligible only through the high-migration rural rule.

columns.name: population
columns.description: Population, 2020-2024 ACS.

columns.name: housing_units
columns.description: Housing units, 2020-2024 ACS.

columns.name: median_household_income
columns.description: Median household income, 2020-2024 ACS (2024 dollars).

columns.name: median_home_value
columns.description: Median value of owner-occupied homes, 2020-2024 ACS.

columns.name: median_gross_rent
columns.description: Median gross rent, 2020-2024 ACS.

columns.name: vacancy_rate
columns.description: Vacant share of housing units, 2020-2024 ACS.

columns.name: owner_occupied_share
columns.description: Owner-occupied share of occupied units, 2020-2024 ACS.

columns.name: bachelors_or_higher_share
columns.description: Adults 25+ with a bachelor's degree or higher, 2020-2024 ACS.

columns.name: unemployment_rate
columns.description: Unemployed share of the civilian labor force, 2020-2024 ACS.

columns.name: built_2020_or_later
columns.description: Housing units built 2020 or later, 2020-2024 ACS.

columns.name: built_2020_or_later_moe
columns.description: Margin of error (90%) of built_2020_or_later.

columns.name: share_built_2010_or_later
columns.description: Share of housing units built 2010 or later.

columns.name: share_built_before_1980
columns.description: Share of housing units built before 1980.

columns.name: jobs_2023
columns.description: Jobs located in the tract, 2023 (LODES); null where LODES has no data for the state and year.

columns.name: jobs_2017
columns.description: Jobs located in the tract, 2017 (LODES); null where LODES has no data for the state and year.

columns.name: mortgage_applications
columns.description: Mortgage applications, 2024 (HMDA), excluding purchased loans.

columns.name: mortgage_originations
columns.description: Mortgage originations, 2024 (HMDA).

columns.name: mortgage_denial_rate
columns.description: Denials over decided applications, 2024 (HMDA); null with no decided applications.

columns.name: home_purchase_originations
columns.description: Home-purchase originations, 2024 (HMDA).

columns.name: originated_dollars
columns.description: Dollars originated, 2024 (HMDA).

columns.name: npl_sites
columns.description: EPA Superfund NPL sites recorded in or at the edge of the tract.

columns.name: brownfield_sites
columns.description: EPA brownfield (ACRES) sites recorded in or at the edge of the tract.

columns.name: colleges
columns.description: Postsecondary institutions in the tract (NCES).

columns.name: hospitals
columns.description: Hospitals placed in the tract (CMS; a floor, as ~14% could not be geocoded).

columns.name: safmr_2br_land_weighted
columns.description: HUD FY2026 two-bedroom Small Area FMR, land-weighted over the ZIPs overlapping the tract.

columns.name: safmr_land_covered
columns.description: Share of the tract's land in ZIPs with a Small Area FMR.

columns.name: miles_to_interstate
columns.description: Miles from the tract's interior point to the nearest Interstate (TIGER 2024); null if none within 150 miles (e.g. Puerto Rico) or not computed.

sources.name: CMS Hospital General Information

sources.name: HUD Small Area Fair Market Rents, FY2026
